user.title: HA Panel
user.description: The tablet is usually discovered automatically. You can add it manually here.

data.api_token: API token (if set in the app)
data.name: Name

zeroconf_confirm.title: HA Panel tablet discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found a tablet at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant? If the app already has an API token, enter it below.

pair.title: Pairing code
pair.description: Enter the 6-digit pairing code shown on the tablet screen (waiting screen or settings).

settings.title: Tablet settings
settings.description: These settings will be sent to the tablet automatically. For the microphone (intercom talk) the dashboard URL must start with https://. You can change them later in the integration options.

data.fallback_urls: Fallback URLs (one per line, e.g. local)
data.night_enabled: Night mode with clock (in the app)
data.night_wake: Night mode: return to clock after (seconds)
data.pin: New settings PIN (min. 4 characters, empty = unchanged; not stored in HA)
data.inject_js: Custom JavaScript run after page load

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair the tablet
reauth_confirm.description: The tablet needs to be re-paired (e.g. after reinstalling the app). Enter the pairing code from the tablet screen. Settings will be sent again.

error.pin_short: PIN must be at least 4 characters

init.title: Tablet settings
init.description: Changes are sent to the tablet immediately.

data.fallback_urls: Fallback URLs (one per line, e.g. local)
data.night_enabled: Night mode with clock (in the app)
data.night_wake: Night mode: return to clock after (seconds)
data.pin: New settings PIN (min. 4 characters, empty = unchanged; not stored in HA)
data.inject_js: Custom JavaScript run after page load

error.pin_short: PIN must be at least 4 characters

popup.name: Popup
popup.description: Shows a page or camera on top, wakes the screen, and returns to the previous view after a while.

url.name: Adres
url.description: Full URL or HA path, e.g. /lovelace/camera

wake.name: Wake screen
wake.description: Wakes the screen and the night clock

title.name: Title
title.description: Label in the top-left corner, e.g. “Doorbell”

export_settings.name: Export settings
export_settings.description: Returns a backup of the tablet settings (without PIN and tokens).

import_settings.name: Import settings
import_settings.description: Sends settings (JSON from export) to the tablet.

say.name: Say on tablet
say.description: Speaks a message with Android TTS on the tablet.
